name: OpenVibe.Work

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

drains: ingest timer stopped (a fetch in flight is abandoned; its rows are written per listing)

resumes.what: the ingest starts again on its timer; each source is fetched when its last fetch is older than 6 hours, so a fetch cut short by a restart is simply redone

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0002 only create Work's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 4960, unit openvibe-work.service. Job listings gathered from open job-board APIs (Arbeitnow, Remotive, RemoteOK) with their provenance: a short plain-text excerpt only, the source named and the original listing linked on every list and page, never the full description. Search with remote/type/location filters, JobPosting JSON-LD, and saved searches with a count of what is new since you last looked. The ingest runs every 6 hours per source when WORK_INGEST=on, upserts by (source, source_id) and expires listings not seen for 30 days. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client work, JWKS). Owns work_listings, work_source_fetches and work_saved_searches. No capabilities yet: saved searches are a person's, listings are public.

site.name: Work
site.tagline: Find work, with an agent on your side
site.what: Job listings from open job boards in one search, each linked back to where you apply, with saved searches that tell you what is new.
